scripts.coverage:client: c8 --all --include "client/**" --exclude "client/demo/**" --reporter text --reporter json-summary --report-dir coverage-client hardhat test && node scripts/check-client-coverage.mjs
scripts.demo:build: mkdir -p client/demo/dist && cp client/demo/index.html client/demo/dist/ && esbuild client/demo/demo.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=client/demo/dist/demo.js --log-level=warning
scripts.demo: npm run demo:build && python3 -m http.server 8788 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory client/demo/dist
